motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle border color shifts to white or red. Data points glow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Use Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.3d_elements: Use react-globe.gl for a holographic red/black earth representation in the Hero or C2 section. Use tsparticles for subtle mesh background in the Contact section.

hero_background.description: Abstract red geometric network on black background
hero_background.treatment: Apply heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80) or use as a fallback if real video bg isn't implemented. Animate slowly if possible.

military_operations.description: Two soldiers walk through a field at dusk
military_operations.treatment: Use in Pre-Mission Planning section. Grayscale filter with a subtle red duotone effect on hover.

ar_headset.treatment: Use for the ARTAK Virtual ROC Drill/Sand Table feature. Darken significantly and add red glow.

hud_abstract.treatment: Use for the Block 2 Features section background, heavily blurred (blur-3xl) and low opacity (opacity-20).

page_sections_instructions.header: Minimalist, sticky nav. Logo (text 'EOLIAN') in Unbounded black. Links in mono font, hover state adds a 1px red underline.
page_sections_instructions.hero: Hero section with video background (mock with asset if needed). Headline: 'MULTI-DOMAIN JOINT PLANNING & C2'. Subheadline: 'Augmented Reality Team Awareness Kit (ARTAK)'. Include 3D element (react-globe.gl) intersecting the right side of the screen. Primary CTA: 'REQUEST DEMO'.
page_sections_instructions.product_artak: Bento grid layout. Mode B (Control Room Grid). 3 main panels: 1. Command & Control (C2), 2. Pre-Mission Planning, 3. Virtual ROC Drill / Sand Table. Each panel should have a distinct visual (globe, tactical map, AR headset) and mono-font labels (e.g., [SYS.01], [SYS.02]).
page_sections_instructions.block_2_features: Technical specs section. Use a 'Tracing Beam' or 'Grid Borders' style. List features with high-contrast icons from lucide-react (Target, Shield, Radio, Crosshair). Red borders on active/hovered items.
page_sections_instructions.device_agnostic: A stripped-down, horizontal layout showing compatibility. Text like 'DEPLOYABLE ON: VR / AR / DESKTOP / MOBILE / ATAK'. Use a slow marquee or a sleek terminal-style bulleted list.
page_sections_instructions.contact: Terminal-style form. Labels in mono font. Inputs are square, bg-transparent, border-b only (or full border-zinc-800). Submit button is full width, solid red, black text.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure red accent (#FF0B1B) against black (#050505) meets APCA standards. If not, use it for borders/accents only, and keep text white.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: Must include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., 'nav-link-products', 'hero-cta-demo', 'contact-submit-button').
